Correspondence.title: Correspondence
Correspondence.body: Correspondence shows your business mail across all contacts: what is unanswered, what belongs to which contact and what you want to file. TILL reads the local mail store your mail client already maintains; there is no password and no sending from inside TILL. A finished draft lands in your mail client’s own drafts folder, where you review and send it yourself.
